title: Why people work
log: 2026-11-04T09:36:47Z write: the API refused it in the chapter request, so it is written on its own next

draft.title: Why people work
card: People work to earn income. Income is the money a person receives, and they use it to pay for what they need and want.
Money is not the only reason. Many people work for a sense of purpose, which means feeling that what they do matters.
Work can also help people build skills, such as teamwork or using new tools, and make friendships with the people they work with.
Some people work to contribute to their community, for example by caring for others or helping local people. Most people have more than one reason.
draft.remember: People work for income, and also for purpose, skills, friendships and to help their community.

a.q: Sam works at a local pool and says, "I love teaching young kids to swim." Which reason for working is Sam mainly giving?
opts: Purpose and contributing to the community
Earning income to pay for goods and services
Gaining skills to use in a later business
a.why: Sam talks about teaching kids, which is about feeling that the work matters and helping others. Income is a common reason to work, but Sam does not mention money here.
a.clue: Sam talks about the children, not about pay.

b.q: Lina has a job at a bakery. She says she enjoys chatting with her workmates each shift and has made close friends there. Which reason for working does this show?
opts: Earning income to buy her needs
Learning how to bake new breads
Helping the community by giving food away
b.why: Lina talks about chatting with workmates and making close friends, so the reason is friendships. Income and skills may also matter to her, but this statement does not mention them.
b.clue: Look at who Lina spends her shifts with.

a.best: Purpose and contributing to the community
